intent.raw: i want to make language and lean validator to converge and be dependent one of another
intent.objective: Design the mutual-dependency convergence architecture between the DomainSpec language and the Lean validator (validator derives obligations/vocabulary from the language; language binds validation authority/promotion to the validator's verdict) without vicious circularity, and produce one non-executed work pack.
intent.operator_sentence: refine: make the language and the lean validator converge and depend on each other

route_menu.context_hint: how the language and the validator couple into one mutually-dependent system

items.label: Shared-core vocabulary
items.description: A single source-of-truth vocabulary (Meta/EdgeType/obligations) that both the language and the validator import. Language authors it; validator consumes it; validator's verdict gates language promotion. Acyclic at the artifact level.

items.label: Layered dependency
items.description: Language is the upper layer (semantic authority), validator the lower (well-formedness authority). Validator depends on language for content; language depends on validator for the validated lifecycle state. Dependency runs in two directions across a layer boundary, not within one artifact.

items.label: Full merge (one system)
items.description: Collapse language and validator into a single DomainSpec system where the language IS the validator's input schema. Maximal coupling; highest circularity/bootstrap risk.

items.label: Compiler pair (derive + check)
items.description: Language artifacts compile deterministically into validator inputs (obligation table + Spec vocabulary); validator results compile back into language lifecycle state. Two one-way compilers form the mutual dependency; neither side hand-edits the other's surface.

subagent_strategy.trigger: convergence has a genuine coupling/circularity dialectic plus a separable dependency-mapping (x-ray) task; three independent lanes sharpen the design and stress the bootstrap risk
subagent_strategy.explanation: A coupling-architect designs the mutual dependency; a dependency-mapper x-rays every edge and its interface; a circularity-skeptic attacks the bootstrap/deadlock and enforces meta-level acyclicity. Parent synthesizes the convergence model + work pack.
context: all evidence local; two prior runs decided model + verdict
the skeptic must be independent to keep the acyclicity argument honest

roles.purpose: Design the bidirectional dependency: how the validator derives obligations/vocabulary from the language, and how the language binds validation-authority/promotion to the validator verdict; pick the coupling seam.

X-ray every dependency edge in both directions, name the realizing interface/artifact for each, and mark exists/designed/missing. Surface hidden edges (e.g. profile selection, EdgeProvenance, promotion gate).

Adversarial: find where mutual dependency becomes vicious (bootstrap deadlock, circular authority, self-validating specs); enforce meta-level acyclicity (content authority vs well-formedness authority separate) and the bootstrap order.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve a full-depth refine run that spawns 3 role-bound subagents (coupling-architect, dependency-mapper, circularity-skeptic) on local evidence, joined by parent synthesis?
